effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, gain 1 memory.
